Name: Iddo, Son of Zechariah
Summary: Son of Zechariah, ruler of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:21: Son of Zechariah, ruler of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Iddo stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
